Class JMDCEditor

                  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.swing.editor.JMDCEditor
All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.accessibility.Accessible, java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable
public class JMDCEditor
extends javax.swing.JPanel

An editor for Manuel de codage text. If you want to manipulate the text, you may do it through the workflow object.

paste

public void paste()
Paste the content of the clipboard into this editor, at the insert position.

Currently supports cut and paste from other JSesh editors, and plain text from other editors. It might be interesting to propose some kind of switch to paste plain text as Manuel de Codage code later.

Other project : we should also support html in a basic way.
